civic_board_comment_id.description: UUID of the target comment whose reactions are being counted. Matches civic_board_comments.id. Included for clarity in read responses; source is the path parameter.

count.description: Total number of active reactions (single-like toggles) for the target comment. This is computed by counting rows in civic_board_comment_reactions where civic_board_comment_id equals the requested comment and deleted_at IS NULL. When reactions are globally disabled or disallowed on comments by civic_board_reaction_policies, providers should return 0 while still succeeding.

ICivicBoardCommentReactionCount.description: Count result for active reactions on a comment. This DTO is a computed response and does not directly map to a Prisma model. It aggregates civic_board_comment_reactions respecting comment/post visibility (civic_board_comments.status and parent civic_board_posts.status). No personal data is included.

id.description: Primary key of the reaction policy record. Maps to civic_board_reaction_policies.id (UUID).

code.description: Unique business identifier for this reaction policy (e.g., "default"). Maps to civic_board_reaction_policies.code and must be unique.

enabled.description: Whether reactions feature is globally enabled. Maps to civic_board_reaction_policies.enabled.

allow_on_posts.description: Whether reactions are permitted on posts. Maps to civic_board_reaction_policies.allow_on_posts.

allow_on_comments.description: Whether reactions are permitted on comments. Maps to civic_board_reaction_policies.allow_on_comments.

allow_self_like.description: Whether self-like is permitted. Product rules typically keep this disabled. Maps to civic_board_reaction_policies.allow_self_like.

max_reactions_per_user_per_day.description: Optional cap on number of reactions a single user may add per calendar day. NULL means unlimited. Maps to civic_board_reaction_policies.max_reactions_per_user_per_day.

created_at.description: Creation timestamp (UTC). Maps to civic_board_reaction_policies.created_at.

updated_at.description: Last update timestamp (UTC). Maps to civic_board_reaction_policies.updated_at.

deleted_at.description: Soft deletion timestamp (UTC) for deprecated or replaced policies. NULL means active. Maps to civic_board_reaction_policies.deleted_at.

ICivicBoardReactionPolicy.description:
Reaction policy configuration entity representing global reactions behavior and guardrails. Backed by Prisma model civic_board_reaction_policies.

This record stores a unique policy code along with boolean feature switches and an optional per-user daily cap. Application logic reads these values to determine if reactions are allowed on posts/comments, whether self-like is permitted, and whether a per-user cap applies. Timestamps provide auditability. No counters are denormalized here; it strictly holds configuration.

page.description: 1-based page index for pagination. Defaults are normalized server-side when omitted or invalid.

limit.description: Maximum number of items per page. Invalid or missing values are normalized to safe defaults by the service.

oneOf.description: Sort by record creation time (UTC).
Sort by record last update time (UTC).
Sort by unique reaction policy code.

order_by.description: Field to sort by for the reaction policies listing.

oneOf.description: Ascending sort order.
Descending sort order.

order.description: Sort direction for the chosen order_by field.

code.description: Filter by exact policy code (globally unique).

code_contains.description: Substring match filter for policy code (case/locale handling is implementation-defined).

enabled.description: Filter by global reactions enablement flag.

allow_on_posts.description: Filter by whether reactions are permitted on posts.

allow_on_comments.description: Filter by whether reactions are permitted on comments.

allow_self_like.description: Filter by whether self-like is permitted.

max_reactions_per_user_per_day_min.description: Lower bound filter (inclusive) for max_reactions_per_user_per_day. Interpreted only when the target column is not null.

max_reactions_per_user_per_day_max.description: Upper bound filter (inclusive) for max_reactions_per_user_per_day. Interpreted only when the target column is not null.

created_at_from.description: Filter: include records with created_at >= this UTC timestamp.

created_at_to.description: Filter: include records with created_at <= this UTC timestamp.

ICivicBoardReactionPolicy.IRequest.description: Request schema for listing, searching, sorting, and paginating reaction policies from civic_board_reaction_policies. Aligns naming with other list DTOs using `limit` for page size and `order` for sort direction. Supports sorting by created_at, updated_at, or code. Unless otherwise authorized, records with deleted_at not null are excluded server-side.

code.description: Unique policy code identifier (e.g., "default"). Must be globally unique across reaction policies. Maps to civic_board_reaction_policies.code.

enabled.description: Whether reactions feature is globally enabled upon creation. Maps to civic_board_reaction_policies.enabled.

allow_on_posts.description: Allow reactions on posts. Maps to civic_board_reaction_policies.allow_on_posts.

allow_on_comments.description: Allow reactions on comments. Maps to civic_board_reaction_policies.allow_on_comments.

allow_self_like.description: Allow self-like. Typically false by product policy. Maps to civic_board_reaction_policies.allow_self_like.

max_reactions_per_user_per_day.description: Optional per-user daily cap on reactions. Provide a non-negative integer to enforce a limit or null to indicate unlimited. Maps to civic_board_reaction_policies.max_reactions_per_user_per_day.

ICivicBoardReactionPolicy.ICreate.description: Create DTO for reaction policies. Only business-editable fields are accepted. System-managed columns such as id, created_at, updated_at, and deleted_at are excluded. Actor/admin identity is taken from authorization context, not the body.

enabled.description: Toggle global reactions enablement. Maps to civic_board_reaction_policies.enabled.

allow_on_posts.description: Toggle whether reactions are allowed on posts. Maps to civic_board_reaction_policies.allow_on_posts.

allow_on_comments.description: Toggle whether reactions are allowed on comments. Maps to civic_board_reaction_policies.allow_on_comments.

allow_self_like.description: Toggle whether self-like is allowed. Maps to civic_board_reaction_policies.allow_self_like.

max_reactions_per_user_per_day.description: Set or clear per-user daily cap. Provide a non-negative integer to enforce a limit or null to remove the cap. Maps to civic_board_reaction_policies.max_reactions_per_user_per_day.

ICivicBoardReactionPolicy.IUpdate.description: Update DTO for reaction policies addressed by unique policy code in the path parameter. All fields are optional to support partial updates. Do not include the policy code here to avoid duplicating the path parameter; the server resolves the target by code from the URL.

generated_at.description: Timestamp (UTC) when this summary was computed.

items.description: Aggregated counts grouped by civic_board_reports.reason. Rows with deleted_at set are excluded from aggregation to reflect retained report data.

ICivicBoardReportStatisticsByReason.description: System-wide summary of report counts by reason. Computed from civic_board_reports via GROUP BY reason and filtered to exclude soft-deleted rows (deleted_at IS NULL).

reason.description: Reporter-selected categorical reason stored in civic_board_reports.reason. Constrained to recognized values (Spam, Harassment, Misinformation, Off-topic, Other).

count.description: Number of civic_board_reports rows for this reason where deleted_at IS NULL (soft-deleted rows excluded).

ICivicBoardReportStatisticsByReason.IIte.description: One entry of aggregated report counts for a specific reason value, computed from civic_board_reports while excluding soft-deleted rows.

generated_at.description: Timestamp (UTC) when this time series snapshot was generated. Provided to align with other analytics DTOs and to aid caching and audit contexts.

data.description: Array of per-day report counts derived from civic_board_reports.created_at truncated to the UTC calendar day. Rows where deleted_at IS NOT NULL are excluded. The series may be sparse (days with zero reports can be omitted). Unless otherwise specified by the endpoint, items are ordered by day descending (newest first).

ICivicBoardReportStatisticsByDay.description: Daily time series of report volumes for administrative trend analysis. Each element represents the number of rows in civic_board_reports created on a given UTC calendar day (DATE_TRUNC('day', created_at)). Excludes soft-deleted rows (deleted_at IS NULL filter). Includes a snapshot timestamp (generated_at) for temporal clarity and cross-schema consistency.

day.description: UTC calendar day represented as an ISO-8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD). Computed by truncating civic_board_reports.created_at to day in UTC.

count.description: Number of reports filed on the given day. Computed as COUNT(*) over civic_board_reports grouped by the truncated day, excluding rows where deleted_at is not null.

ICivicBoardReportStatisticsByDay.IItem.description: One row of the per-day time series. Represents a single UTC day bucket and its total report count sourced from civic_board_reports.

total_count.description: Total number of reports matching the applied filters (sourced from civic_board_reports), excluding soft-deleted rows (deleted_at IS NULL).

by_reason.description: Breakdown of report volumes by categorical reason. Reasons align with business policy values stored in civic_board_reports.reason.

by_status.description: Breakdown of report volumes by workflow status (e.g., pending, resolved) based on civic_board_reports.status.

by_target_type.description: Breakdown by target type as determined by the specialization linkage: civic_board_report_of_posts (post) vs civic_board_report_of_comments (comment).

series_by_day.description: Per-day time series for the result set using civic_board_reports.created_at truncated to UTC day.

by_decision.description: Optional breakdown of resolved reports by moderator decision, derived by joining civic_board_moderation_actions on civic_board_report_id. When not applicable or no decisions exist, providers may return an empty array or omit this field.

ICivicBoardReportAnalytics.description: Administrative analytics object summarizing user-submitted content reports. Aggregations are computed from civic_board_reports and, when needed, its specializations (civic_board_report_of_posts, civic_board_report_of_comments) and moderation resolutions (civic_board_moderation_actions) for decision-based breakdowns. It provides totals, categorical breakdowns (reason, status, target type, decision), and a daily time series, excluding soft-deleted rows. This DTO contains derived data only and does not map 1:1 to a single Prisma model.

reason.description: Categorical reason captured in civic_board_reports.reason. Values follow board policies (e.g., Spam, Harassment, Off-topic, Other, Misinformation).

count.description: Number of reports with the given reason in the filtered set.

ICivicBoardReportAnalytics.IReasonCount.description: Count of reports grouped by a specific reason value stored in civic_board_reports.reason.

status.description: Workflow state from civic_board_reports.status (e.g., pending, resolved). Exact values depend on moderation queue policies.

count.description: Number of reports currently in the given status within the filtered set.

ICivicBoardReportAnalytics.IStatusCount.description: Count of reports grouped by civic_board_reports.status.

target_type.description: Discriminator of specialization: 'post' for civic_board_report_of_posts, 'comment' for civic_board_report_of_comments.

count.description: Number of reports for the specified target type within the filtered set.

ICivicBoardReportAnalytics.ITargetTypeCo.description: Count of reports grouped by the type of target entity (post vs comment) as determined by specialization tables. Aggregation is derived from civic_board_reports joined with civic_board_report_of_posts (post) or civic_board_report_of_comments (comment) and EXCLUDES soft‑deleted rows (where civic_board_reports.deleted_at IS NULL).

day.description: UTC calendar day represented as an ISO‑8601 date (YYYY‑MM‑DD). Computed via DATE_TRUNC('day', civic_board_reports.created_at) in UTC.

count.description: Number of reports on the given UTC day within the filtered set (excluding soft‑deleted rows).

ICivicBoardReportAnalytics.ITimeBucket.description: A single per‑day bucket for the analytics time series. Each bucket’s day is computed in UTC from civic_board_reports.created_at (DATE_TRUNC('day')), and the count EXCLUDES rows where civic_board_reports.deleted_at IS NOT NULL to reflect retained report data.

IECivicBoardReportReason.description: Alias of IECivicBoardReportReason. Use the canonical IECivicBoardReportReason for report reason validations. This alias preserves backward compatibility while eliminating duplication.

Report has been resolved (e.g., decision recorded in civic_board_moderation_actions).

IECivicBoardReportStatus.description: Enumeration of moderation queue states reflected in Prisma column civic_board_reports.status. Minimal scope supports exactly two states: "pending" and "resolved". Use this enum consistently in analytics and admin views; do not introduce additional states without updating policy and Prisma schema.

oneOf.description: Target type discriminator used for analytics derived from specialization tables: 'post' corresponds to civic_board_report_of_posts; 'comment' corresponds to civic_board_report_of_comments.
Target type discriminator used for analytics derived from specialization tables: 'post' corresponds to civic_board_report_of_posts; 'comment' corresponds to civic_board_report_of_comments.

id.description: Primary key of the configuration record. Maps to civic_board_configurations.id.

key.description: Unique configuration identifier (e.g., "public_read", "attachments.max_count"). Maps to civic_board_configurations.key and serves as the human/business lookup key.

ICivicBoardConfiguration.ISummary.description:
Summary view of a system-wide configuration entry from civic_board_configurations. This type is optimized for list and reference contexts and contains the identifier, the configuration key, and its typed value fields.

It reflects the design of the Prisma model where a configuration is stored as an independent key-value record with multiple typed columns (value_string, value_int, value_double, value_boolean, value_uri). Only one typed value column is typically populated for a single row. No foreign keys exist for this table as configurations are intentionally decoupled from domain content and identities.

id.description: Primary key of the policy record. Maps to civic_board_policies.id.

policy_code.description: Stable policy identifier (e.g., "public_read", "attachments.policy"). Unique across the system. Maps to civic_board_policies.policy_code.

name.description: Human-friendly policy name for administrative UIs. Maps to civic_board_policies.name.

category.description: Optional category for grouping related policies (e.g., "visibility", "attachments"). Maps to civic_board_policies.category.

value_string.description: Optional textual value governed by the policy. Maps to civic_board_policies.value_string.

value_int.description: Optional integer value (e.g., numeric limits). Maps to civic_board_policies.value_int.

value_double.description: Optional decimal value (e.g., MB limits with fractional precision). Maps to civic_board_policies.value_double.

starts_at.description: Optional start of the policy’s effective window (UTC). Maps to civic_board_policies.starts_at.

ends_at.description: Optional end of the policy’s effective window (UTC). Maps to civic_board_policies.ends_at.

notes.description: Administrative notes describing policy rationale or change context (not shown to end users). Maps to civic_board_policies.notes.

updated_at.description: Last update timestamp (UTC). Maps to civic_board_policies.updated_at.

ICivicBoardPolicy.ISummary.description:
Summary view of a system policy from civic_board_policies. Optimized for listing and embedding in other responses, it exposes the identity, primary code, on/off state, and optional effective window and values.

This mirrors the Prisma model where each policy is an independently managed record with optional typed value columns and an effective period (starts_at/ends_at). Policies are used by application logic to enforce behaviors such as public-read, attachment constraints, and reporting limits.

ICivicBoardAuditLog.ISummary.description:

This summary focuses on identification, actor context, action/outcome, optional target reference, and the creation time for ordering. It omits internal update/delete timestamps to keep payload minimal for list usage. Sensitive credential data is never stored here and therefore not exposed.

id.description: Primary key of the rate-limit record. Maps to civic_board_rate_limits.id.

ICivicBoardRateLimit.ISummary.description:
Rate-limit summary DTO for monitoring and admin list views. Mirrors key window metadata and counters from Prisma model civic_board_rate_limits.

image_height.description: Image height in pixels for image types; null for non-image attachments. Maps to civic_board_post_attachments.image_height.

uploader.description: Uploader user reference transformed from civic_board_post_attachments.civic_board_user_id. Actor reference is presented as a summary object (not raw FK) per DTO rules.

created_at.description: Attachment creation timestamp (UTC). Maps to civic_board_post_attachments.created_at.

updated_at.description: Attachment last update timestamp (UTC). Maps to civic_board_post_attachments.updated_at.

ICivicBoardPostAttachment.ISummary.description: Summary representation of a Post Attachment derived from Prisma model civic_board_post_attachments.
